messages:
olivia: Quick q — planning a small team breakfast at the Istanbul office next Wed. Any favorite kahvaltı spots near Levent/Maslak? Also what's a reasonable per-person budget? (options: 60-100₺, 100-150₺, 150+₺) :coffee:

murat: Van Kahvaltı Evi is great for proper Turkish breakfast. It's a sit-down spread, expect ~120₺ pp. https://goo.gl/maps/van-kahvalti-example

jon: Simit Sarayı if people are in a rush — cheap + reliable. 30-50₺.

ciara: Karaköy has some cute places (Kale Cafe, Namlı Gurme) if people want a view — prob 150₺+ with coffee.

ben: 100-150₺ seems fair. we want full kahvaltı, not just simit.

maria: +1 for 100-150. need a vegetarian/vegan-friendly spot though.

raj: Menemen + sucuk + simit = yes. If budget allows, order extra vegetarian cheese plates.

olivia: @murat would you be able to check availability for Van Kahvaltı Evi? if not I'll call.

murat: I can—I'll check today and post updates. can we cap headcount at 12? (office table space)

infra-bot: Note — office capacity set to 12 people for in-person events. See #office-resources for details.

ciara: quick check — anyone strongly prefer a <100₺ option? react with :thumbsup: for yes

jon: :thumbsup: (reacted)

ben: :thumbsup:

maria: prefer 100-150, no reaction

olivia: Poll tally so far: 2 for <100₺, 4 for 100-150₺ (including verbal), 1 for 150+.

murat: booked a tentative slot for 10 people at Van Kahvaltı Evi, 09:30 Wed. will confirm pricing.

olivia: amazing — I'll add to calendar and ping travel for per-diem reimbursements. thanks everyone :tada:
